title: Selectively targeting the IKKbeta by 11,11'-methylenebisdibenzo[a, c]phenazine (SIKB-7543) downregulates aberrant NF-kappaB signaling to control the proliferation and induce apoptosis in Hodgkin lymphoma.
authors: Abohassan, Mohammad; Al Shahrani, Mesfer Mohammad; AlOuda, Sarah Khaled; Rajagopalan, Prasanna
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子抑制剂靶向IKKbeta调控NF-kappaB信号通路治疗霍奇金淋巴瘤，属于药物-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hodgkin lymphoma (HL) develops in the part of the immune system that is centrally aggravated by the NF-kappaB signaling. Selectively targeting IKKbeta to downregulate the NF-kappaB-mediated disease progression helps control this dreadful malignancy. This study evaluated novel and selective IKKbeta inhibitors to downregulate aberrant NF-kappaB signaling in HL. GROMACS, GMX_MMPBSA, and PLIP were used after high-throughput virtual screening against the ChemBridge library to identify leads. The in vitro effectiveness was evaluated using flow cytometry, luminometry, and spectrometry on RPMI 666 and Hs 445 cells. HTVS identified SIKB-7543 with favorable binding affinities of -14.2 kcal/mol toward IKKbeta. MD simulations established stable bonding for SIKB-7543 and IKKbeta with RSMD values around 0.07 nm. The DeltaG binding calculation was -50.46 kcal/mol, favoring sturdy binding. ADME analysis favored small-molecule characteristics. SIKB-7543 inhibited IKKbeta activity with an IC(50) value of 118 nM. The compound effectively controlled the proliferation of RPMI 666 and Hs 445 cells with GI(50) values of 345.6 nM and 320.5 nM, respectively. SIKB-7543 prompted dose-responsive apoptosis in the HL cells. Cell-cycle analysis demonstrated a concentration-dependent increase in the sub-G(0) population in both cell lines following SIKB-7543 treatment, while decreasing the NF-kappaB-p65 (Rel A) positive populations in TNFalpha-stimulated RPMI 666 and Hs 445 cells dose-dependently. Results suggest SIKB-7543 is a selective IKKbeta inhibitor that downregulates aberrant NF-kappaB signaling, controls proliferation, and induces apoptosis, warranting further preclinical developments to counter HL malignancy.
abstract_zh: 霍奇金淋巴瘤（Hodgkin lymphoma, HL）发生于免疫系统中，该系统的功能受NF-kappaB信号通路显著激活。选择性靶向IKKbeta以下调NF-kappaB介导的疾病进展，有助于控制这种恶性疾病。本研究评估了新型选择性IKKbeta抑制剂，以抑制HL中异常的NF-kappaB信号传导。通过针对ChemBridge文库的高通量虚拟筛选，使用GROMACS、GMX_MMPBSA和PLIP工具鉴定先导化合物。体外有效性通过流式细胞术、发光法和光谱法在RPMI 666和Hs 445细胞系中评估。HTVS筛选出SIKB-7543，其对IKKbeta具有有利的结合亲和力，为-14.2 kcal/mol。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟显示SIKB-7543与IKKbeta之间形成稳定结合，RSMD值约为0.07 nm。DeltaG结合能计算为-50.46 kcal/mol，表明结合牢固。ADME分析支持其小分子特性。SIKB-7543抑制IKKbeta活性，IC(50)值为118 nM。该化合物有效控制RPMI 666和Hs 445细胞的增殖，GI(50)值分别为345.6 nM和320.5 nM。SIKB-7543在HL细胞中诱导剂量依赖性凋亡。细胞周期分析显示，在SIKB-7543处理后，两种细胞系的sub-G(0)群体呈浓度依赖性增加，同时TNFalpha刺激的RPMI 666和Hs 445细胞中NF-kappaB-p65（Rel A）阳性群体呈剂量依赖性减少。结果表明，SIKB-7543是一种选择性IKKbeta抑制剂，可下调异常NF-kappaB信号传导、控制增殖并诱导凋亡，值得进一步开展临床前开发以对抗HL恶性病变。
